evals.prompt: I want to build an n8n workflow that listens for a webhook from Stripe (payment succeeded events) and sends a Slack message to #payments channel with the customer name and amount. I already have Slack credentials set up in n8n.
evals.expected_output: A complete workflow with: Webhook trigger node, IF node to filter for payment.succeeded events, Slack node sending to #payments with expression-based customer name and amount from $json.body, validation run, and the workflow activated. Should correctly use $json.body.data.object.customer for Stripe webhook data, not $json.customer.

evals.prompt: Can you make an n8n workflow that runs every morning at 8am, fetches the top 5 posts from the Hacker News API, and emails me a summary? My email is test@example.com.
evals.expected_output: Workflow with Schedule Trigger (cron: 0 8 * * *), HTTP Request node fetching HN API, Code node to format top 5, Email/Gmail node sending to test@example.com. Should guide user on email credentials if not set up.

evals.prompt: I need an AI agent workflow in n8n that can answer questions about my company. It should use Claude as the LLM and have a tool that can do web searches.
evals.expected_output: AI Agent workflow with: Chat Trigger or Webhook trigger, AI Agent node (toolsAgent type), Anthropic Chat Model connected via ai_languageModel, SerpAPI or similar search tool connected via ai_tool. Correct AI connection types used. Validation passes.
